news.headline: NKTR Stock Soars After Nektar Reports Positive Atopic Dermatitis Trial Results
Nektar's (NKTR) Billion-Dollar Balance Sheet Faces A Multi-Year Test
news.summary: A post-earnings analysis frames Nektar's investment case around its $1.02 billion cash balance (runway into Q3 2028) against the multi-year wait for Phase 3 rezpegaldesleukin data. It notes ZENITH AD topline results are not expected until mid-2028, with a BLA filing to follow in 2029 if results hold.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Peer-reviewed 16-week induction data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD study were published in The Lancet, providing full efficacy, safety, pharmacodynamic and biomarker findings on rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. The study met all primary and key secondary endpoints, including EASI-75, EASI-90, Itch NRS, vIGA-AD and BSA, at the 24 microg/kg q2w dose.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Reaffirms Their Buy Rating on Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR)
news.summary: Piper Sandler maintained its Buy rating and $151 price target, citing rezpegaldesleukin's advancing Phase 3 programs in atopic dermatitis and alopecia areata and its disease-modifying potential.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: Nektar reported cash and investments of $1.023 billion (up from $245.8M at year-end 2025), extending runway into Q3 2028, and confirmed the ZENITH AD Phase 3 atopic dermatitis trials are enrolling while the design for a single registrational Phase 3 study in alopecia areata has been finalized with the FDA. Management reiterated mid-2028 topline ZENITH AD data and a planned 2029 BLA submission.

news.headline: Nektar v. Eli Lilly pretrial conference sets September 8, 2026 jury trial date
news.summary: A pretrial conference in Nektar's breach-of-contract suit against former rezpeg partner Eli Lilly set a jury trial to begin September 8, 2026 in the Northern District of California, after the court denied Lilly's motion for summary judgment in March 2026. Nektar alleges Lilly mishandled and delayed the drug's atopic dermatitis/psoriasis trial data before returning rezpeg rights in 2023.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program Evaluating Novel Regulatory T-Cell Biologic Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar began randomizing patients in the first two of three pivotal ZENITH AD studies (ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, 510 patients each, ages 12+) for rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis. A third study, ZENITH AD-3, enrolling treatment-experienced patients, is expected to start by the end of September 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial start
catalysts.detail: Third pivotal Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis, enrolling patients with prior biologic/JAK-inhibitor experience, expected to begin.

catalysts.label: Alopecia areata Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Single registrational Phase 3 study of rezpegaldesleukin in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata to start, based on Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA data and a finalized design following FDA alignment.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly financial results and pipeline update; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data (AD-1/AD-2)
catalysts.detail: First readout from the registrational Phase 3 atopic dermatitis program, the key long-term value inflection point for rezpegaldesleukin.

catalysts.label: Planned BLA submission for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis
catalysts.detail: Contingent on positive ZENITH AD Phase 3 results; company has guided to a 2029 U.S. filing.

pulse: NKTR trades around $75 (as of late August 2026), having rallied sharply over the past year as rezpegaldesleukin advanced into Phase 3 for atopic dermatitis (ZENITH AD, enrolling since July 2026, third study ZENITH AD-3 due to start by end of September) and alopecia areata (design finalized with FDA, start planned early 2027), backed by a $1.02 billion cash position from Q2 2026 results that funds operations into Q3 2028. The August 25 Lancet publication of positive REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b induction data reinforced the scientific case, and analyst sentiment remains strongly bullish (Piper Sandler Buy, $151 PT; broader consensus near Strong Buy), but the story is still a multi-year wait for pivotal data (ZENITH AD topline not due until mid-2028, BLA planned for 2029), with a near-term legal overhang from Nektar's breach-of-contract suit against former partner Eli Lilly, set for jury trial on September 8, 2026.
